scoring.description: Subjective investment hypotheses informed by adjacent channel evidence, NOT empirically measured success probabilities.
scoring.range: Each criterion is scored 1 (weak) to 5 (strong). Weighted score = sum(weight * score / 5).

concepts.one_line: A two-character micro-laboratory tests harmless-looking gadgets that spectacularly misunderstand physics.
concepts.format: 20-65 second primarily silent Shorts with occasional 2-3 minute specials
concepts.production_style: Original blocky SVG rigs, 2-4 locations, elastic scale/squash, custom foley
example_hooks: A Button That Makes Every Object Polite
risks: No cloned cartoon silhouettes or gags

concepts.one_line: An underfunded municipal office processes impossible cosmic mishaps as if they were parking tickets.
concepts.format: 3-6 minute serialized episodes plus 30-45 second original clip edits
concepts.production_style: Original angular cutout characters, fluorescent bureaucratic interiors, deadpan reaction holds
example_hooks: Permit for a Small Black Hole
risks: Human comedy editing is a bottleneck
Do not emulate The Big Lez Show's named characters, dialect, world, or designs

concepts.one_line: Every episode decodes one eerie radio transmission from a fictional city that vanished from maps.
concepts.format: 4-8 minute narration-driven anthology with 20-45s suspense teasers
concepts.production_style: Original low-motion graphic-novel cutouts, moving shadows, editorial camera pushes, sound-led scares
example_hooks: The Elevator Only Stops on Yesterday
The Street That Has No End
risks: Graphic or shocking content can reduce ad eligibility
No fake true-crime claims; every story explicitly fictional

concepts.one_line: Low-budget helper robots perform simple jobs while misunderstanding every human instruction.
concepts.production_style: Minimal vector robots and limited mouth animation
risks: Generic robots require unusually strong visual distinction

concepts.one_line: An imaginary courtroom tries absurd disputes between fictional concepts like Luck, Monday, and Battery Life.
concepts.audience: Comedy fans and legal professionals; adult but broadly advertiser-safe
concepts.format: 45-90 second sketch hearings and 3-5 minute trials
concepts.production_style: Paper-theater courtroom; 4 static angles; expressive concept characters
example_hooks: Battery Life Is Held in Contempt
risks: Make courtroom absurd rather than legal advice
Keep IP separate from professional legal software branding

concepts.one_line: A city's residents discover reality runs on an incompetent operating system.
concepts.audience: Gaming, tech and surreal comedy fans
concepts.production_style: 2D rigs with UI overlays, pixel-snap glitches, cheap procedural transitions
risks: Overused simulation premise demands distinctive comedic point of view

concepts.one_line: Anonymous paranormal creatures staff a citywide customer-support desk for bizarre service outages.
concepts.production_style: Original headset/face rigs, phone-call cutaways, limited locations
example_hooks: Please Hold While We Restore the Moon
risks: Folkloric designs should not imitate specific creator-owned cryptids

concepts.one_line: Museum exhibits start arguing about what humans have gotten wrong about history.
concepts.audience: Teens and adults who enjoy art, humor, and lore
concepts.format: 3-5 minute episodic comedy with Shorts extracts
concepts.production_style: Paper-cutout exhibits, static galleries, minimal walk cycles
example_hooks: The Portrait Is Tired of Smiling
risks: Art and historical claims need provenance; fictionalize instead of giving false facts

concepts.one_line: Invented minor deities share a tiny dispatch office and argue over human requests.
concepts.production_style: 2D cutout mythology-inspired but fully original silhouettes
example_hooks: Deity of Lost Socks Is Promoted
risks: Avoid religious hate and copyrighted modern mythology depictions

concepts.one_line: A local animated weather presenter forecasts impossible but strangely mundane phenomena.
concepts.production_style: One avatar, reusable map graphics, animated type and VFX
example_hooks: Cloudy With a Side of Tuesday
risks: Can become repetitive unless every episode changes premise and consequences

concepts.one_line: Miniature rivals conduct epic politics over a kitchen countertop.
concepts.format: 4-8 minute serials with a season arc
example_hooks: A Treaty Is Signed on a Napkin
risks: Larger cast and action increase art costs

concepts.one_line: Future archivists misinterpret everyday internet behavior as ancient rituals.
concepts.production_style: Illustrated artifacts, simple talking hosts, motion graphics
risks: Never use unlicensed screenshots, clips, music, or other creators' creative works
